environment_fixes.finding: Four local TLS tests used relative certificate paths; four timeout cases target an external unroutable address.
environment_fixes.resolution: Use the source working directory and retain the four external-address cases as explicit offline SKIP.

environment_fixes.finding: A parameter embeds the installed pytest filename, which differs between ABI environments.
environment_fixes.resolution: Normalize only known installation roots to site-packages/ in all test IDs.

environment_fixes.finding: The upstream legacy collector gives three no-data cases the same node ID.
environment_fixes.resolution: Append the original function name to no-data item IDs; keep all three cases.

environment_fixes.finding: Release wheels omit the source test packages.
environment_fixes.resolution: Call the upstream unittest loader with source test paths attached to the installed lxml packages.

environment_fixes.finding: The suite marks no_cover cases through its coverage plugin.
environment_fixes.resolution: Explicitly load the hash-pinned pytest-cov plugin.

environment_fixes.finding: The timezone tests import Pydantic in addition to pydantic-core.
environment_fixes.resolution: Pin and install Pydantic and its dependency closure for the test environment.

environment_fixes.finding: Asyncio test modules import greenlet even with --disable-asyncio.
environment_fixes.resolution: Exclude test/ext/asyncio at collection within the declared synchronous SQLite lane.

environment_fixes.finding: The release unit-test CI installs Matplotlib on Python 3.14.
environment_fixes.resolution: Pin and install its wheel closure before the final baseline.

environment_fixes.finding: The release default CI environment includes NumPy, SciPy, pandas and Matplotlib.
environment_fixes.resolution: Pin those wheel dependencies; include doctests and the release image-comparison lane.

environment_fixes.finding: Importlib collection hid the res fixture package and changed a module-name assertion.
environment_fixes.resolution: Use the release CI default prepend import mode for this package.

environment_fixes.finding: Six doctests access samples/ and doc/ relative to the source root.
environment_fixes.resolution: Use the release source root as the working directory, as the upstream test runner does.

environment_fixes.finding: Custom parameter IDs include process addresses, random UUIDs and Rust hash-map repr order.
environment_fixes.resolution: Use pytest callspec parameter names/indices as stable IDs; retain original IDs in runtime JSON and raw journals.

environment_fixes.finding: An upstream 0.1-second deadline can interrupt failure reporting under instrumentation.
environment_fixes.resolution: Apply a five-second minimum to pytest timeout markers, preserving socket timeout arguments and assertions.

environment_fixes.finding: The suite checks module-qualified reprs and globbing relative to the source root.
environment_fixes.resolution: Use the source working directory and default prepend import mode, as CI does.

environment_fixes.finding: Golden syntax colors depend on the Pygments version; forcing COLUMNS overrides tests of descriptor fallback.
environment_fixes.resolution: Use Pygments 2.19.2 from the release poetry.lock and unset COLUMNS/LINES for this suite.

environment_fixes.finding: The release uv.lock uses the urllib3 Hypercorn fork at d1719f8c1570cbd8e6a3719ffdb14a4d72880abb; PyPI Hypercorn lacks its TLS and _transport scope extensions.
environment_fixes.resolution: Load that exact source archive as a test-server dependency, with a SHA-256 pin. Production urllib3 remains the published wheel.

environment_fixes.finding: fontTools 4.68.0 cp314t bezierTools enables the GIL; Matplotlib loads it for the PS backend.
environment_fixes.resolution: Use the published fontTools pure Python wheel in both environments and rerun the graph suite.

environment_fixes.finding: The upstream collector omits nine tutorial methods on free-threaded builds because DocTest requires gil_enabled.
environment_fixes.resolution: Keep the full GIL-derived inventory and map this exact allowlist to SKIP in the free-threaded manifest.

environment_fixes.finding: The sdist has no dependency lock and current doc tooling rejects 25 unchanged documentation examples during lint, before running them.
environment_fixes.resolution: Pin pytest-examples 0.0.15, Black 24.10.0 and Ruff 0.9.2 from the available upstream main uv.lock snapshot. A matching release-tag lock was unavailable (unverified). Assertions and examples remain unchanged.

environment_fixes.finding: Two unmarked HTTP/2 thread-probe cases connect to reserved internet address 240.0.0.0 (TARPIT_HOST). The offline guard makes their intended connect-timeout/thread scheduling assumptions invalid.
environment_fixes.resolution: Keep both TLS variants in the denominator as explicit offline SKIP.

environment_fixes.finding: The shared corpus environment supplies optional lxml, which enables the GIL and caused a free-threaded GraphML crash. NetworkX default CI dependencies omit lxml.
environment_fixes.resolution: Use package-specific environments omitting lxml and lxml-html-clean. Keep the full frozen inventory, with upstream dependency skips and an exact allowlist for the omitted GraphML doctest module. lxml retains its own corpus lane.

environment_fixes.finding: Four upstream file-URI fixtures embed home-directory syntax in their generated parameter labels. They are static test data, rather than machine paths.
environment_fixes.resolution: Use parameter indices for this one test family and keep its original labels only in external journals, respecting the public-path rule.

upstream.classification: Reproduced FAIL on both pinned oracles with TZ=UTC, including a repeat run. The preceding test requires gettz(UTC) is tz.UTC while this test expects tzlocal for every local alphabetic abbreviation.
upstream.resolution: Retain FAIL in the scoreboard; no assertion or timezone is changed.

upstream.classification: GzipDecoder.flush propagates zlib.error on concatenated gzip data followed by garbage. Reproduced on both pinned oracles after the CI-server and offline-selection repairs.
upstream.resolution: Retain FAIL; no assertion or production package is patched.

upstream.classification: The trailing gzip garbage reaches the same unhandled zlib.error during flush. Reproduced on both pinned oracles after the CI-server and offline-selection repairs.
upstream.resolution: Retain FAIL; no assertion or production package is patched.

upstream.classification: The test expects OSError from a closed socket, but CPython 3.14 first raises ValueError for check_hostname without server_hostname. Reproduced on both pinned oracles after the CI-server and offline-selection repairs.
upstream.resolution: Retain FAIL; no assertion or production package is patched.

upstream.classification: The published cp314t extension declares that it uses the GIL. Its own free-threaded-ABI suite passes with the automatically enabled GIL.
upstream.resolution: Keep the observed GIL state explicit and the driver nonzero; no forced GIL-off setting or rebuilt extension is used. No-GIL lxml compatibility remains unverified.
